item.title: KFSH performs SEEG on toddler under the age of two
item.description: King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre (KFSH) has successfully performed stereoelectroencephalography (SEEG) on a toddler under the age of two. The child, who has tuberous sclerosis complex complicated by severe drug-resistant epilepsy, underwent the intervention after medical therapy failed to control her recurrent seizures.
